olivia: Heads up 0min sync 01 0we need a repeatable sandbox handoff for LangChain/LlamaIndex + gateway demo next week. Goal: standardized creds, demo dataset snapshot, and failover plan.

jess: I can take checklist + runbook. Do we want a single demo user or per-partner tokens?

olivia: Prefer per-partner short-lived tokens so we can revoke quickly. Also need a one-page security attestation for legal.

sam: Tech note 0we should issue JWTs via temp-creds with scope claims and TTL. Sample claim format (stringified in the doc): { exp:1680000000, scope:["generate","embeddings"], project:"partner-sandbox" }

sam: We can add IP allowlist and require partner to use our SDK key header x-rwd-demo.

mike: From product/sales side: quota to prevent runaway spend. Suggest demo quota=75k tokens and billing flag disabled. Also want a single snapshot dataset versioned in S3.

jess: Adding quota + dataset snapshot path to checklist. Will include rollback steps to swap to quantized model if latency > 350ms.

olivia: integrations-bot create ticket and assign to partnerships + eng-infra + legal.

integrations-bot: Created PARTNER-4910 - "LangChain demo: sandbox creds, dataset snapshot, attestation" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNER-4910

sam: I'll author the rotation script and a sample token with 7-day TTL and push a gist link in the ticket.

mike: I'll upload dataset snapshot and a small validation prompt set so partner can smoke test determinism.

jess: Draft checklist will include: auth format, TTL policy, IP restrictions, quota config, dataset snapshot path, demo runbook steps, legal attestation checklist, contact list.

olivia: Great. Timeline: drafts by EOD, final handoff Tue AM.

sam: PR for rotation script by 6pm.

jess: checklist+runbook by 5pm.

mike: dataset snapshot + validation prompts by 4pm.

olivia: thanks all 0closing notes in PARTNER-4910 and will schedule a 30m dry-run with LangChain on Monday. :rocket:
